entities.summary: Brett Grant Vroman is an American former professional basketball player. A 7'0" 220 lb center, he played college basketball for the UCLA Bruins and UNLV Runnin' Rebels. His professional career included a brief stint with the NBA's Utah Jazz and 12 years playing in Europe.
